description: The ratio column divides each kept telescope's average modulation index by the overall average, which is the mean of the per-telescope averages across all telescopes.

c.request: For each telescope (`telescref`) in the signals table, compute its average modulation index (`modindex`), ignoring missing values. Then list the telescopes whose average is above the overall average, taking the overall average as the mean of the per-telescope averages. For each one, show the telescope reference, its average modulation index, how much it exceeds the overall average, and its average as a ratio to the group average. Return the top 10 by that ratio, highest first, without rounding. The ratio column divides each kept telescope's average modulation index by the overall average, which is the mean of the per-telescope averages across all telescopes.
c.sql:
WITH telescope_averages AS (
  SELECT telescref, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex
  FROM signals
  GROUP BY telescref
  HAVING AVG(modindex) IS NOT NULL
), overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) AS group_avg_modindex
  FROM telescope_averages
)
SELECT
  ta.telescref,
  ta.avg_modindex,
  ta.avg_modindex - oa.group_avg_modindex AS excess_over_group_avg,
  ta.avg_modindex / oa.group_avg_modindex AS ratio_to_group_avg
FROM telescope_averages AS ta
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
WHERE ta.avg_modindex > oa.group_avg_modindex
ORDER BY ratio_to_group_avg DESC
LIMIT 10;

a.request: For each telescope (`telescref`) in the signals table, compute its average modulation index (`modindex`), ignoring missing values. Take the overall average to be the mean of these per-telescope averages, so each telescope counts once. Keep only the telescopes whose average is above that overall average. For each one, show the telescope reference, its average modulation index, how far it is above the overall average (its average minus the overall average), and its average divided by the overall average. Sort by that ratio from highest to lowest and return the top 10, without rounding.
a.sql:
WITH telescope_averages AS (
  SELECT telescref, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex
  FROM signals
  GROUP BY telescref
), overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) AS overall_avg_modindex
  FROM telescope_averages
)
SELECT
  ta.telescref,
  ta.avg_modindex,
  ta.avg_modindex - oa.overall_avg_modindex AS above_overall_average,
  ta.avg_modindex / oa.overall_avg_modindex AS ratio_to_overall_average
FROM telescope_averages AS ta
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
WHERE ta.avg_modindex > oa.overall_avg_modindex
ORDER BY ratio_to_overall_average DESC
LIMIT 10;

b.request: For each `telescref`, compute the average non-null `modindex`; compute the overall average as the unweighted mean of those per-telescope averages across all telescopes; keep telescopes whose average exceeds it; return the top 10 ordered by descending ratio of each telescope’s average to the overall average, showing the telescope reference, its average, its difference from the overall average, and that ratio, without rounding
b.sql:
WITH telescope_averages AS (
  SELECT telescref, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex
  FROM signals
  WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY telescref
), overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) AS overall_avg
  FROM telescope_averages
)
SELECT ta.telescref,
       ta.avg_modindex,
       ta.avg_modindex - oa.overall_avg AS difference_from_overall,
       ta.avg_modindex / oa.overall_avg AS ratio_to_overall
FROM telescope_averages ta
CROSS JOIN overall_average oa
WHERE ta.avg_modindex > oa.overall_avg
ORDER BY ratio_to_overall DESC
LIMIT 10;

d.request: For each telescope in the signals table, compute its average modulation index, ignoring missing values. Keep telescopes whose average exceeds the overall average, defined as the mean of all per-telescope averages. For each kept telescope, show its reference, average modulation index, excess over the overall average, and the ratio of its average to the overall average. Return the top 10 by ratio, highest first, without rounding.
d.sql:
WITH telescope_averages AS (
  SELECT telescref, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex
  FROM signals
  GROUP BY telescref
), overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) AS overall_avg
  FROM telescope_averages
)
SELECT ta.telescref,
       ta.avg_modindex,
       ta.avg_modindex - oa.overall_avg AS excess_overall_avg,
       ta.avg_modindex / oa.overall_avg AS ratio_to_overall_avg
FROM telescope_averages ta
CROSS JOIN overall_average oa
WHERE ta.avg_modindex > oa.overall_avg
ORDER BY ratio_to_overall_avg DESC
LIMIT 10;
